latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 9; addi.d $r5, $r0, 10; addi.d $r6, $r0, 11; addi.d $r7, $r0, 12; addi.d $r8, $r0, 13; addi.d $r9, $r0, 14; addi.d $r10, $r0, 15; addi.d $r11, $r0, 16
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 9; addi.d $r5, $r0, 10; addi.d $r6, $r0, 11; addi.d $r7, $r0, 12; addi.d $r8, $r0, 13; addi.d $r9, $r0, 14; addi.d $r10, $r0, 15; addi.d $r11, $r0, 16' --asm 'addu12i.d $r12, $r4, 1; addu12i.d $r13, $r5, 1; addu12i.d $r14, $r6, 1; addu12i.d $r15, $r7, 1; addu12i.d $r16, $r8, 1; addu12i.d $r17, $r9, 1; addu12i.d $r18, $r10, 1; addu12i.d $r19, $r11, 1'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
